summary.text: David Gomberg is a state representative from Oregon House District 10 who took office in 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election on the Democratic, Republican and Independent Party of Oregon lines.

paragraphs.text: Gomberg earned a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's degree from Oregon State University in 1977, and an MBA from Willamette University in 1981.
He has been president of Northwest Winds Kite Stores and Gomberg Kite Productions and worked as an administrative law judge for the Motor Vehicles Division from 1985 to 1987.
Gomberg assumed office in 2013 and advanced from both the Democratic and Republican primaries on May 19, 2026.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as co-vice chair of the Joint Ways and Means Committee and a member of the Joint Committee on Semiconductors.
